messages:
ana: Quick sync — finalizing the newsletter + webinar handoff for the Benchmark report launch next Wed. Need segmentation, subject lines, and the invite flow by EOD Tue. Who can own the subject A/Bs?
liam: I can own the subject line tests. thinking two angles: product-first vs benchmark-first. will draft 4 variants by tomorrow morning.
maria: I'll map the segments. my plan: 1) existing users w/ recent api usage; 2) trialers who used embeddings; 3) cold list (last active >180d). we should also add a 'platform partners' segment for the APAC list.
devin: For the webinar invite cadence: suggest 3-touch sequence — initial invite, reminder (48h), last-chance (2h). Should we add a pre-invite to the trialers with a CTA to claim early access seats?
ana: @devin tiny nit: my calendar blocks Tue PM for copy review. can we aim to finalize cadence by Tue 2pm so i can review?
emily: I'll take the landing page + registration form. quick ask: do we want company logo + 1 quote on the form or keep it lean? leaning lean for conversion.
liam: subject line candidates (first pass):
- `Redwood Benchmark: See how your costs compare — webinar + report`
- `Benchmark results + live walkthrough — seats limited`
- `Reduce inference cost: benchmark highlights + demo`
- `How teams cut token spend — benchmark + live Q&A`
maria: segmentation notes — deliverable list: csv filters for each cohort, ideal send windows (timezone buckets), suppression lists (opt-outs + customers in current campaign). i'll drop the exports in #marketing-assets after lunch.
devin: cadence snippet (copy for campaign builder):
```
Day 0: Invite — 1pm local (subject A/B)
Day 3: Reminder — 10am local (short highlight + speaker names)
Day 5: Last chance — 2pm local (urgent language + 1-click add to calendar)
```
ana: @liam thanks for the lines — can you also create sms variants? a short 2-line version for trialers.
liam: yup — prepping sms now. examples: `Webinar Wed: Redwood Benchmark + live demo. RSVP: <link>`
emily: Landing page mockup ready by EOD today — will post link. prefilling industry + team size fields to aid routing.
campaign-bot: Reminder set: send final subject lines to #marketing by 2026-03-24T18:00Z.
maria: small ask — can we run the APAC send earlier (9am SGT) to hit morning inboxes? that may shift cadence by 8–12h.
devin: good call. we'll create timezone buckets: AM+EMEA, APAC morning, Americas afternoon.
ana: Action items recap: 1) @liam — deliver 4 subject lines + SMS variants by Tue AM. 2) @maria — segment CSVs + send windows by Tue lunch. 3) @emily — landing + reg form by EOD. 4) @devin — cadence copy + campaign builder setup by Tue 5pm. I'll review Tue 2–4pm. cc: ops for suppression list sync. :thumbsup:
liam: on it.
maria: on it.
emily: yup.
devin: will do.
ana: Thanks team — ping me if anything blocks.
